summary: §34 profile-photo + location backend fully tested. 18/19 assertions passed (1 skipped/flagged). Photo upload (JPEG/PNG, client + coach), 400 on unsupported mime, 413 on >5MB, previous-file unlink on replace, header-and-query auth on GET, cross-role (coach→client) view, 404 when absent, and full DELETE tear-down all work correctly. Location upsert persists all six fields (city/country/tz/source/permission_status/last_updated_at). Permission endpoint validates enum. Aviation branding fields (job_title, airline, home_base, aircraft_type, route_focus) persist under user.profile.* and round-trip via /api/auth/me. Social-studio regression endpoints (/api/social/settings, /api/social/posts) still return 200. One minor spec deviation: POST /api/user/location with empty body {} returns 200 instead of the 400 'no updates' called out in the request (dead-code branch — endpoint always seeds timestamps first).

minor.issue: Spec says empty body → 400 'no updates', but endpoint returns 200 because `updates` dict is preseeded with `location_last_updated_at` and `updated_at` before the emptiness check (feature_profile.py:174-183). The `raise HTTPException(400, 'no updates')` branch is unreachable. Fix: build `updates` from optional fields FIRST, check emptiness, then add timestamps.

action_items: (Minor) Reorder POST /api/user/location body handling in feature_profile.py so that when city/country/tz/source/permission_status are all None the endpoint returns 400 'no updates' as spec'd. Currently timestamps are added first, making the 400 branch dead code.
critical_code_review_comments: feature_profile.py:82-85 correctly early-aborts on >5MB but writes chunks up to the limit to disk before unlinking; acceptable for a 5MB cap. No streaming DoS risk observed.
feature_profile.py:144-147 auth branching: header path calls current_user() which raises 401 on missing/invalid; query-token path uses local _user_from_token(). Both enforced correctly.
GET /api/user/profile/photo/{user_id} intentionally allows any authenticated user to view any other user's photo (documented in code). Confirmed working across coach↔client.
UserProfilePatch (server.py:1543-1562) writes all aviation-branding fields under user.profile.* — persists correctly and returns via /auth/me.
seed_data_creation: No seed data added. Uses seeded client@crewfit.com + coach@crewfit.com. Test uploads/deletes are self-cleaning via the DELETE endpoint at end of TestProfilePhoto.
context_for_next_testing_agent: test_profile_photo_location.py is idempotent (deletes photo it uploaded). PIL is available in the runtime for generating in-memory JPEGs/PNGs. Storage root: /app/backend/uploads/profile_photos/<user_id>/. Photo GET accepts EITHER Authorization: Bearer <token> header OR ?token=<jwt> query param.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/user/location empty-body: the `updates` dict is initialized on feature_profile.py:175 as `{'location_last_updated_at': now, 'updated_at': now}` — so by the time the code reaches `if not updates` on line 182 it is ALWAYS non-empty. Reproduction: `curl -X POST .../api/user/location -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>' -d '{}'` → HTTP 200 with `location_last_updated_at` bumped. Mitigation: initialize `updates: dict = {}`, add optional fields, `if not updates: raise 400`, then set the two timestamps.
